- If connect is NaN, return val.
- If val is NaN, return val. (Actually returns val, but if val is NaN, returns val which is NaN.)
- Compute diff = val - connect.

- diff2 = connect - result;
- If |diff2| < |diff|, val = result;
- return val.

- Check metadata.name equals call.name else WRONG_METHOD_NAME
- Try to receive result: call.receive(protocol, metadata); read message end; return result

        - refreshAfterStatusChanged(false, true, row - topRow, col - leftCol, cell, updateGui)
        - return false
